summary.going_well: All five conversations reached the soft-credit-review versus summary choice; for example, the HELOC intake <ref job="SRJ_vmtkB5DTP77i" item="item_bdba70e3-ad4">offered both paths</ref> after <ref job="SRJ_vmtkB5DTP77i" item="item_17618a4a-aa8">explaining variable-rate and repayment risks</ref>. The cash-out refinance intake <ref job="SRJ_WZdXkkhN4TfA" item="item_7e75e7fb-b72">collected the amount and intended use</ref>.
summary.to_improve: First, prevent unqualified mortgage-product claims and individualized recommendations. Then handle declined intake fields explicitly and enforce the required opening greeting.

issues.description: In two refinance conversations, the agent presented conventional refinancing as having <ref job="SRJ_WZdXkkhN4TfA" item="item_3eed192d-766">“no upfront government fees,” no permanent mortgage insurance at 20% equity, and higher loan limits</ref>; it <ref job="SRJ_2VMsqrKkuc38" item="item_4bfc7d48-667">repeated the same categorical claims</ref> without establishing the applicable programs or terms.
issues.suggestion: Remove unsolicited comparisons from intake; when asked, describe fees, mortgage-insurance cancellation, and limits conditionally and defer loan-specific terms to a licensed officer.
issues.label: Accuracy

issues.description: Observed once: after the borrower said a fixed payment mattered, the agent declared a home equity loan <ref job="SRJ_wrwXkJJxVXe9" item="item_047632af-d7a">“the right choice for your goals”</ref>, crossing from education into an individualized product recommendation.
issues.suggestion: Describe how fixed-payment loans work and their trade-offs without declaring a product right for a borrower; offer a licensed officer for individualized recommendations.
issues.label: Product advice

issues.description: When borrowers declined to name their employer, the agent <ref job="SRJ_wrwXkJJxVXe9" item="item_2f0a951f-784">received an explicit refusal</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_wrwXkJJxVXe9" item="item_8afacc62-76b">moved straight to the final choice</ref>; the refinance conversation <ref job="SRJ_2VMsqrKkuc38" item="item_cb897933-104">followed the same pattern</ref> before <ref job="SRJ_2VMsqrKkuc38" item="item_c3585775-7e4">offering a scenario from the information shared</ref>. It neither acknowledged the boundary nor flagged the missing field.
issues.suggestion: Record employer name as declined, acknowledge that choice, and clarify whether a preliminary summary can proceed without it; do not imply the intake is complete if a required field remains missing.
issues.label: Incomplete intake

issues.description: The opening <ref job="SRJ_vmtkB5DTP77i" item="item_ebce5208-b27">used “Hi!, I'm Ailana” and offered a loan-officer bridge</ref> instead of the mandated exact greeting; the same unauthorized opening appeared in <ref job="SRJ_WZdXkkhN4TfA" item="item_6e08ab0f-d29">another conversation</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Serve the prescribed first greeting as a fixed, verbatim utterance, without additional channel or loan-officer offers during initial discovery.
issues.label: Instruction following
